mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing atenolol metabolism and increasing sympathomimetic sensitivity, while atenolol's beta-blockade can mask hypertensive crisis symptoms from MAOI interaction with sympathomimetics.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close monitoring for hypertensive crisis, arrhythmias, and ensure at least 14 days washout of tranylcypromine before starting atenolol.
